messages:
jess (customer): Hey team — since yesterday our embed pipeline started returning vectors with mixed dims. 1 in 10 responses are 1536 dims, rest 1024. Happening after we switched to client-side synchronous batching in TS SDK.
maya (support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you share a minimal repro and request/response headers?
jess (customer): repro attached. We batch 4 items per request with `client.embeddings.create({input: [...], model: 'open-vector-1024'})` in TS SDK. Logs: `vec_len=1024` most times but occasionally `vec_len=1536`. No change on our side except updating SDK to 1.5.0 last week.
maya (support): thanks. @olivia can you take SDK side. @samir can you look at server batching?
olivia (sdk): on it. quick question: are you using the new ``syncBatch`` helper or rolling your own?
jess (customer): we switched to the SDK helper `batcher.syncBatch(inputs, {maxBatchSize:4, timeoutMs:50})`.
olivia (sdk): hmm — we shipped a change that splits large payloads across code paths; there was a bug where the helper could mix model variants when a retry raced with a subsequent batch. assigning to me to reproduce.
samir (eng): server note: we have a fallback path that uses a 1536-dim model family for throughput degradation. If routing metadata gets dropped on retry it could produce mismatched dims. Looking into logs for that trace id.
build-bot: deploy 3309876200 to inference-prod succeeded in 4m.
maya (support): jess can you paste one raw request/response pair (headers + body) where dim=1536?
jess (customer): pasted below:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: r-9a6c
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-1024",
  "input": ["foo","bar","baz","qux"]
}
```
Response code: 200
```
{
  "data": [ {"embedding": [0.001,...(1536 floats)...], "index":0}, ...]
}
```
maya (support): thanks — that X-Request-Id helps. @samir any trace for r-9a6c?
samir (eng): found it. On our side the request was retried by the gateway when a short 504 from backend occurred. Retry went to a fallback pool that hosts `redwood-embed-1536` family. Gateway should preserve `model` param but looks like in the retry path we forwarded only the original `route` and lost `model` override. That would explain mixed dims.
jess (customer): so this is on your retry routing? We saw a single 504 in our client logs then got a 200 after retry.
samir (eng): yes. root cause likely gateway bug + timing with SDK batching retries. We should fix gateway to preserve full payload metadata on internal retries.
olivia (sdk): reproducer I ran locally: TS SDK `syncBatch` will attempt up to 2 retries on 5xx by default. If a retry for batch A races while batch B is queued the helper can re-use a pooled request object without updating `model` header in a small window. Patch incoming to zero-copy; adding an idempotency key per outer-batch should prevent cross-batch bleed.
ryan (devex): suggested mitigation for customers: set `retry: { maxRetries:0 }` on SDK or set `timeoutMs` to larger than gateway's retry window. Also pin `model` param explicitly per call.
maya (support): jess would you be ok trying a quick test: upgrade SDK to patch >=1.5.2-beta (olivia will share), or set `maxRetries:0` and confirm for one hour?
jess (customer): yes we can test `maxRetries:0` for a few hours — can you share exact config?
olivia (sdk): sample config:
```ts
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, embeddings: {batch: {maxBatchSize:4, timeoutMs:200}, retry: {maxRetries:0}}})
```
Also we'll cut 1.5.2 with a guard that ensures per-batch request clones.
samir (eng): on infra side I'll add an assert in gateway logs to ensure `model` preserved on internal retries and emit an alert if mismatch occurs. Patch ETA ~2h and hotfix rollback ready.
maya (support): I'll coordinate and monitor. @jess please run the no-retry config and post a small sampling if you still see dim mismatch.
jess (customer): started test, will report by EOD. Thanks. :pray:
olivia (sdk): follow-up: created branch `fix/batcher-clone-req` with tests that simulate retry races. Also added an integration test that asserts embedding lengths uniform across batch.
build-bot: ci/test (sdk) passed for fix branch.
samir (eng): infra patch deployed to canary. initial canary shows no `model` drift traces for retries.
jess (customer): quick interim update — after disabling retries we see 0 mismatches in 2k requests. Looks good so far.
maya (support): awesome, leaving this open until infra + sdk patch land. Will update thread when we ship.
ryan (devex): postmortem items: 1) add end-to-end test covering embedding-dim consistency under retries 2) document recommended retry configs for embeddings 3) add dashboard metric for `response_dim != requested_dim`.
maya (support): filing a support follow-up with the customer once patches are released.
jess (customer): thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. :rocket:
